findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "robots" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: no_arguments_lint_this_hosts_robots_txt, am_i_allowed, example, lint_robots_txt · Private data: no_arguments_lint_this_hosts_robots_txt, am_i_allowed, whoami, example, lint_robots_txt, check_path_allowed, audit_ai_access, diff_robots_txt, merge_policy · Public sink: no_arguments_lint_this_hosts_robots_txt, am_i_allowed, whoami, example, lint_robots_txt · Destructive: no_arguments_lint_this_hosts_robots_txt, example.
